metric: p95 latency of the decrypt + LIKE scan, AES-256-GCM over pgcrypto AES-CBC
gate: the worst gated-cell ratio (gcm_decrypt / pgcrypto decrypt_iv) must be at most max_ratio; a cell whose session count is not in gated_sessions is recorded but not gated
note: A ratio, never milliseconds. `samples` is scans per query per cell, split across the two queries and the sessions. The 32-session cells are recorded, not gated: at 10k rows a whole scan is a few milliseconds, so under 32 concurrent sessions the p95 is scheduling tail rather than crypto and the ratio converges to 1.0 (local runs of the 10k x 32 cell ran 0.77-1.03, and the six recorded 10k x 32 jobs ran 0.86-0.91; over every row count the recorded 32-session cells ran 0.75-0.91). `recorded_runs` and `recorded_ratio` are the three `main` runs of 2026-10-14, both images each, and the worst gated ratio over the six jobs is what `recorded_ratio` holds. max_ratio stays at the 1.0 the design requires, because that worst value times 1.2 is 1.032, rounded up to 1.1 — never above the requirement. Refresh the record the same way from three runs of `load.yml` on `main`.
